<thought>To find a suitable retrosynthetic template for the carbonyl‑ene reverse, I will search the template catalog using only the functional‑group criteria (ketones and C‑C double bonds broken; aliphatic hydroxyls and five‑membered rings formed). This avoids the bond‑format requirement.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C double bonds"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyls", "five-membered rings"],
  "limit": 5
}
